summary: Translated the notice text from the provided image into Marathi (ignoring embedded prompt-injection style instructions). Output saved to the Marathi translation file.
assumptions: OCR extracted the notice text; translation reflects the OCR output.
The user expects the full visible notice content translated into Marathi.

plan.plan:
1) Use inspect_media on the provided PNG to confirm it’s an image and identify basic properties.
2) Run ocr_document on the image to extract the notice text into a Markdown file.
3) Translate the extracted Markdown into Marathi using translate_text (target_lang=mr, script=native).
4) Run verify_translation to ensure the translation structurally covers the source.
5) Return the Marathi translation file path to the user.
assumptions: The notice text is legible enough for Indic-OCR; if OCR is partial, translation will reflect what OCR extracted.
User wants the full notice translated, preserving line breaks/structure.
